description: A document with no prompt/use of its own: --adapter still ranks as the cli source over the config's own default_adapter ('scripted'), and --allow-capabilities still lands in _capability_allow, sorted and deduplicated, even though nothing in this document needs either -- both observable only in runtime.effective_settings, never in the document's own output. 'ollama' (not an agent-CLI adapter) avoids needing a fakes/ binary for an adapter this case never actually dispatches.
